pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Tan-colored, irregularly shaped polygonal regions. Patches on the upper shoulder and neck are larger and exhibit radiating star-like projections with soft pixel gradients at the edges. Lower flank patches are smaller, more densely clustered, and transition into more rounded geometries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored negative space forming a continuous web. Junction nodes vary in width, with broad intersections on the upper torso narrowing into thin, high-frequency pathways on the lower limbs and ventral area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical crease or skin fold is visible mid-flank, creating a structural interruption in the flow of the pelage pattern from the shoulder to the hindquarters.
